restoration_note: The teaching maps the soul's options through the Zone (the natural's complete circuit): four ways of regeneration leading up to life, eight ways of corruption pouring into Gehenna. The latter eight subdivide into five operating through the flesh (lawlessness, separation/killing of body, wounding word, plus two more) and three of falsity (Error pouring, blasphemy mocking the gods, plus the rest of Error). Restorations are largely constrained by the parallel structure (4 light-ways vs. 8 error-ways), the directional vector pairs (ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈/ⲁⲡⲓⲧⲛⲉ), the Greek loan ⲙⲉⲧⲁⲗⲗⲓⲥⲙⲟⲥ split across a line, and the editor's transparent letter-traces. {11} ⲡⲱⲣⲝ̄ ('separation') is restored as the Coptic name for 'killing' (separation of soul from body), matching partial ⲡ̄...ⲝ̄ and the explicit gloss ⲉⲧⲉ ⲡϩⲱⲧⲃⲉ ⲡⲉ. {13} verb of striking is taken as ⲣⲁϩⲧ̄ 'smites' — least-marked choice for a 4-char striking verb governing ⲡⲥⲧⲁⲩⲣⲟⲥ ⲙⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ — but with low confidence since several near-synonyms fit. {12} ⲙⲁϥ supplies the obligatory Coptic resumptive object pronoun for the relative ⲡⲉⲧⲟⲩϩⲁϣϩⲱ̄, with no English correlate.

coptic_restorations.basis: Directional preposition ⲁ- 'to' bonded with the article ⲡ- of ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ; parallel to 'ascending up to life' below. The four ways are reckoned ⲁⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ 'to the light'.

Lyc. qualitative of ⲙⲟⲩⲭⲧ 'be mingled' (lexicon: ⲙⲟⲩⲭⲧ = the unregenerate state of light and darkness not yet sorted). The eight downward ways are characterized by mingling — light caught with what is claimed.
Initial ⲁⲍⲣ- of ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈ 'upward'; the Lyc. directional adverb completed by surviving ⲏⲓ̈. Required by the upward extraction of the light from the eight ways into the doctrinal vessels.
Directional ⲁ- 'to' + plural article ⲛⲉ before ⲭⲏⲩ (ships); ⲁⲛⲉⲭⲏⲩ 'unto the ships' is the destination of the rescued light, the doctrinal vessels carrying truth across the natural waters.
Lyc. directional 'downward', the structural inverse of ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈ above. The Error is removed downward and cast, undergoing transmutation (ⲙⲉⲧⲁⲗⲗⲓⲥⲙⲟⲥ) into another condition.

Internal letter of Greek loan μετάλλισμος / ⲙⲉⲧⲁⲗⲗⲓⲥⲙⲟⲥ 'transmutation', supplying the ⲓ between ⲙⲉⲧⲁⲗⲗ- and -ⲥⲙⲟⲥ. Lexicon: metarrhismos/metallismos = transfer of a state from one substrate to another.

Editor restores ⲥⲁⲣⲙⲉ 'Error' (= ⲡⲗⲁⲛⲏ); plural relative ⲛⲉⲧ- is required because the antecedent is ⲡⲕⲉϣⲁⲙⲧ ⲙⲙⲁⲓⲧ 'the other three ways' (plural). Yields 'the three ways of the Error, those which pour forth into Gehenna'.

Editor restoration: ⲁⲃⲁⲗ closes a preceding verb of revelation ('made known forth'), and ⲭⲉ ⲡϣⲁⲙⲧ ⲙⲙⲁⲓⲧ 'that the three ways' picks up the three Error-ways from line 13 — the ones explicitly reckoned to ⲡⲥⲁⲣⲙⲉ.
Circumstantial ⲉ- + 3pl ⲩ + qualitative ⲥⲏⲕ 'be drawn'; mirrors ⲛⲉⲧⲥⲏⲕ ⲁⲛⲅⲉⲉⲛⲛⲁ in the previous segment. The eight ways draw the soul through the flesh.
Standard Coptic enumerative idiom ⲡⲟⲩⲉ ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲩ 'one of them', initiating the list of the eight ways before ⲡⲙⲁϩⲥⲛⲉⲩ 'the second' (4701) and ⲡⲙⲁϩϣⲁⲙⲧ 'the third' (4703).
Greek loan ⲁⲛⲟⲙⲓⲁ (ἀνομία 'lawlessness') split across the line break: ⲛ̄ⲧ-[ⲁⲛⲟ]ⲙⲓⲁ. The first of the eight downward ways: the natural mind multiplied apart from the Lord's order.

Matches partial ⲡ̄...ⲝ̄ at est. 4 chars; ⲡⲱⲣⲝ̄ 'separation' (Sahidicizing form of Lyc. ⲡⲱⲣⲭ) glossed in apposition by ⲉⲧⲉ ⲡϩⲱⲧⲃⲉ ⲡⲉ 'which is the killing' — separation of soul from body as the second downward way.

3 chars completing the obligatory resumptive object pronoun ⲙ̄ⲙⲁϥ 'it' for the Coptic relative clause ⲡⲉⲧⲟⲩϩⲁϣϩⲱ̄ ⲙ̄ⲙⲁϥ ϩⲛ̄ ⲥⲁⲣⲝ̄ ⲛⲓⲙ 'that which they multiply [it] in all flesh'. The ⲙ̄- is the close of the previous line.

4-char verb of striking governing ⲙ̄ⲡⲥⲧⲁⲩⲣⲟⲥ ⲙ̄ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ 'the cross of the Light'. ⲣⲁϩⲧ̄ 'smite' is the least-marked Coptic verb fitting the stated semantic and length; the wounding word 'smites' the cross of the Light (the rational suffering as it is purified) and every body.
Editor restoration: ⲡⲕⲉ-ⲥⲉⲡⲉ 'the rest/remainder' (cf. attested ⲥⲉⲡⲉ/ⲥⲉⲧⲧⲉ 'remainder'). Picks up 'the rest of the Error' to introduce the further error-ways (blasphemy that mocks the gods).
Editor restoration: ⲭⲓⲟⲩⲁ (= ϫⲓⲟⲩⲁ) 'blasphemy', paired with ⲡⲗⲁⲛⲏ as a cosmic principle and explained immediately by the relative ⲉⲧϣⲱⲃⲉ ⲛ̄ⲛ̄ⲛⲟⲩⲧⲉ 'that mocks the gods'.

english_restorations.basis: Renders the directional preposition ⲁ- supplied by the Coptic restoration ⲁⲡ; the four ways are reckoned 'to the light'.
Translates qualitative ⲙⲁⲭⲧ from ⲙⲟⲩⲭⲧ; lexicon's standard rendering for the unregenerate state where light and what the soul has claimed are not yet sorted.
Lexicon's standard rendering of ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈ as 'upward'; the directional vector of the light's rescue.
Renders ⲁ- + ⲛⲉ- (preposition + plural article) supplied by Coptic restoration; ⲁⲛⲉⲭⲏⲩ = 'to the ships' (doctrinal vessels).

Lexicon-anchored rendering of ⲁⲡⲓⲧⲛⲉ; the inverse vector to ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈, governing the casting-down of the Error. The internal letter ⲓ of 'transmutation' (gap {5}) is absorbed into the whole English word and needs no separate placeholder.
Renders ⲥⲁⲣⲙⲉ ⲛⲉⲧ — 'Error' as cosmic principle (lexicon rendering of ⲥⲁⲣⲙⲉ = ⲡⲗⲁⲛⲏ) plus the plural relative referring back to the three Error-ways.
Renders ⲁⲃⲁⲗ (closing a verb of revelation in the lost preceding text) + ⲭⲉ 'that' + ⲡϣⲁⲙⲧ 'the three' — the three blasphemy/error ways already named.
Renders circumstantial ⲉⲩⲥⲏⲕ; mirrors the editor's English of ⲛⲉⲧⲥⲏⲕ in the previous segment ('those that draw down to Gehenna').
Renders ⲡⲟⲩⲉ in the enumerative idiom ⲡⲟⲩⲉ ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲩ 'one of them', opening the list before 'the second' and 'the third'.
Standard rendering of Greek loan ἀνομία/ⲁⲛⲟⲙⲓⲁ; the whole word is folded into this segment since the bulk of letters (-ⲙⲓⲁ) lies here while ⲛ̄ⲧ- ends the previous segment.

Renders ⲡⲱⲣⲝ̄ in its base sense ('separation'), then immediately glossed in the Coptic itself as ⲉⲧⲉ ⲡϩⲱⲧⲃⲉ ⲡⲉ 'which is the killing'. The resumptive ⲙⲁϥ in gap {12} has no English correlate, so I emit no placeholder for it.
Renders ⲣⲁϩⲧ̄ 'smite/strike' — the verb governing 'the cross of the Light and every body'. Confidence kept low because several near-synonyms could fit the 4-char slot.
Renders ⲥⲉⲡⲉ 'the rest/remainder' (the ⲡⲕⲉ- prefix sat at the end of the prior segment); 'the remainder of Error' introduces the further error-ways.
Standard rendering of ⲡⲭⲓⲟⲩⲁ (= ϫⲓⲟⲩⲁ) 'the blasphemy'; explained immediately by the relative 'that mocks the gods'.
